notes: Kodak's own servers carry this edition only in Spanish and Portuguese (TI-2657); the URL
is an archive of the English one.
Sensitometric curves: 5500 K daylight, 1/50 s, Process ECN-2, Status M densitometry. The
exposure axis is calibrated from the camera-stop ticks, one stop being 0.301 log H, with
stop 0 at log H -0.515 as labelled: the grey card's exposure at EI 50, so Log H ref. The
plot's lux-second labels at its ends (-3.03 and 2.006) would make a stop 0.315: they are
not used. -0.515 agrees with the ISO relation of Kodak's still films (log10(0.8 / 50) +
Spectral sensitivity (page 4): effective exposure 1/10 s, Process ECN-2, Status M, density
0.2 above D-min. Spectral dye density (page 5): ECN-2, D-mins subtracted; a midscale
neutral and the minimum density (drawn dashed, as one continuous path).
Page coordinates: the plots' axes are calibrated from their tick marks.
